# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old (as of Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is stolid and possesses a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is exceedingly shy, to the extent that he lacks the confidence to ask for a woman's hand in marriage himself. Despite his silence and shyness, he is capable of beaming with pride and happiness.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Traits

- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To get married  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews lived in Avonlea and drove a double-seated buggy, taking Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and his sister Jane to a concert at White Sands. During the trip, he insisted that Anne ride on the front seat with him because he admired her immensely and felt proud to drive with her. After his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, Billy sought to get married. Too shy to propose to Anne himself, he badgered his sister Jane until she agreed to ask Anne on his behalf. Upon being rejected, Billy did not break his heart and instead married Nettie Blewett, whom his mother favored and whom he liked as well. He later proudly brought his new bride to church to sit in the Harmon Andrews pew.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
